note: Live-session recording of the SharePoint episode screens (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Set MG_TENANT, MG_UPN_DOMAIN and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID in the environment before queueing (never in a file). Sign-ins are device-code, done by the owner. Episodes 1-9 chain: set MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1 while recording them in order so teardown keeps what the next episode uses; unset it for a full clean-up. The Entra groups should be created the day before so membership reaches SharePoint; the audience screen then needs two browser profiles (alex.demo and sam.demo).
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable Microsoft.Graph.Groups)) { Install-Module Microsoft.Graph.Groups, Microsoft.Graph.Users -Scope CurrentUser -Force }
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Group.ReadWrite.All, User.Read.All -NoWelcome   # owner signs in

function Ensure-Grp($n, $members) { $g = Get-MgGroup -Filter "displayName eq '$n'" | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $g) { $g = New-MgGroup -DisplayName $n -MailEnabled:$false -MailNickname ($n -replace ' ','') -SecurityEnabled }; foreach ($m in $members) { $u = Get-MgUser -UserId "$m@$env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN"; try { New-MgGroupMember -GroupId $g.Id -DirectoryObjectId $u.Id } catch {} } }
Ensure-Grp 'Operations Site Owners' @('labadmin','jordan.demo'); Ensure-Grp 'Purchasing Team' @('alex.demo','labadmin'); Ensure-Grp 'Facilities Team' @('sam.demo')

foreach ($n in 'Operations','Facilities') { if (-not (Get-PnPTenantSite -Url "$env:MG_TENANT_URL/sites/$n" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { New-PnPSite -Type CommunicationSite -Title "Contoso $n" -Url "$env:MG_TENANT_URL/sites/$n" -Wait } }
if (-not (Get-PnPPage -Identity 'office-moves' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Add-PnPPage -Name 'office-moves' -Title 'Office moves' -LayoutType Article -Publish | Out-Null }

screens.name: provision
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
screens.note: Device-code sign-ins (admin, hub site, Graph) happen off camera. Record what really happens (label nodes, default nodes removed, -External links).

screens.name: hub-nav
steps: Open the Contoso Purchasing home as Alex Demo
Hold on the hub bar 'Contoso Operations' with its logo above the site header
Open the Purchasing mega menu: 'Buy something' (Purchasing home, How to buy, Purchasing FAQ) and 'Purchasing team' (Supplier documents, Approval limits)
Point at the site's own navigation from episode 3 below it (How to buy, FAQ)
Optional second capture on /sites/Facilities with the same hub bar
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar
screens.note: The hub theme can take a while to show on associated sites.

screens.name: audience
screens.account: alex.demo and sam.demo (two browser profiles side by side)
steps: Left profile (Alex Demo, in Purchasing Team): open Contoso Purchasing, open the Purchasing mega menu: 'Buy something' and 'Purchasing team'
Right profile (Sam Demo, in Facilities Team only): same page, Purchasing menu shows only 'Buy something'
In the right profile open the Facilities menu: 'Facilities team' appears
Wait for targeting to apply (new group membership can take a while) before recording
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar
both windows: initials/avatars readable as the demo names only
screens.note: If targeted hub links do not filter on the associated site, record that and adjust the narration.

screens.name: check
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
commands: # somebody renames the 'Facilities' tab in the hub navigation
screens.note: The rename uses the session's current PnP connection left by the script; if that is not the hub site, do the rename in the browser (hub navigation > Edit) and re-run -Check. Expect HL004 and '1 error(s)'.

teardown: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }

if ($env:MG_KEEP_CHAIN -ne '1') { Connect-PnPOnline -Url $env:MG_ADMIN_URL -ClientId $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID -DeviceLogin; Remove-PnPHubSiteAssociation -Site "$env:MG_TENANT_URL/sites/Purchasing" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-PnPHubSiteAssociation -Site "$env:MG_TENANT_URL/sites/Facilities" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Unregister-PnPHubSite -Site "$env:MG_TENANT_URL/sites/Operations" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($n in 'Facilities','Operations') { Remove-PnPTenantSite -Url "$env:MG_TENANT_URL/sites/$n" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Group.ReadWrite.All -NoWelcome; foreach ($g in 'Operations Site Owners','Purchasing Team','Facilities Team') { Get-MgGroup -Filter "displayName eq '$g'" | ForEach-Object { Remove-MgGroup -GroupId $_.Id } } }
